Class GameCharacter

java.lang.Object
main.character.GameCharacter
Direct Known Subclasses:
Enemy, Player
public abstract class GameCharacter extends Object
Base class for all game characters (players and enemies). Manages character stats, equipment, inventory, and combat actions.

    • GameCharacter

      public GameCharacter(String name, double maxHealth, int strength, int dexterity, int intelligence)
      Creates a new game character with specified attributes.
      Parameters:
      name - The character's name
      maxHealth - The maximum health points
      strength - Strength stat (affects physical damage, range 1-10)
      dexterity - Dexterity stat (affects turn order, range 1-10)
      intelligence - Intelligence stat (affects magic damage, range 1-10)
